title: Decision: String::from_utf8_lossy for resilient SSE stream decoding
description: Line 197 uses String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes) to decode arriving SSE chunks. If a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence is split across two network packets, this gracefully skips invalid bytes rather than panicking. The buf accumulation pattern (lines 192, 200-202) ensures complete events are handled. This is intentional robustness: malformed UTF-8 on the network (from buggy servers or corruption) is handled without crashing.
